name: switched-burst-release
title: DC/DC burst pause and release
purpose: Bus PRECHARGED to 406 V, above the 405 V pause threshold, 10 kΩ load, BUSREG from t = 0. Checks that the converter starts paused with both legs off, and releases when the load has drained the bus to 395 V. Repeated cycles need the bus to rise to 405 V again.
